verdict.meaning: Reject current selection and promotion; do not claim that the three economic mechanisms are disproved.

candidate_dispositions.title: Pre-redemption SPAC trust-claim discount convergence
direct_blockers: all candidate-specific surfaces are snapshot-only and partial
zero candidate overlap, zero independent rows and zero settled rows
no primary broker evidence for eligibility, cutoff, accepted instruction, fees or cash release

candidate_dispositions.title: Fungible ADR versus home-share parity convergence

candidate_dispositions.title: Assignment-aware executable put-call parity residual

history_audit.spac_neighbor_interpretation: Cash-tender convergence is economically adjacent and cost/carry sensitive, but SPAC redemption is not automatically an illegal duplicate; a distinct broker/execution contract and settled rows are required.
history_audit.put_call_interpretation: The machine-listed FINRA candidates are not semantic put-call-parity neighbors; the valid veto is options data/execution maturity, not an assertion that executable parity has already been tested.
